interface.reading: SEP arms of af3/pt2/bt2 give confident interfaces (ipTM ~0.9, xgb-DockQ ~0.7-0.8); unmodified af3 control and of3 are weak (ipTM ~0.5): phosphate drives confidence, as D1 expected; of3 likely did not carry SEP or is weaker on peptides
